reason: The opening universal claim is ill-typed: an arbitrary complete metric space has only a distance d, not vector subtraction h_{n+1}-h_n or a norm ||h_{n+1}-h_n||. Thus the displayed contraction estimate is not a meaningful statement under the stated hypotheses. Replace both normed differences by d(h_{n+1},h_n) and d(h_1,h_0), or restrict the fixed-point claim to a complete normed space; the later application to K does not repair the overbroad universal statement as written.
